parameters.formDescription: Upload the webinar registrant/attendee export (Zoom, GoTo or ON24 CSV). It is cleaned, de-duplicated against HubSpot, enriched with Clay + DeepSeek, scored and routed to SDRs.

values.placeholder: Darwinbox Cortex and the AI-Native Era of HCM

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ row_id: $json.id, first_name: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.firstname, last_name: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.lastname, email: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.email, job_title: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.jobtitle, organization: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.company, company_domain: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.company_domain, country: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.country, attended: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.attendance, time_in_session_min: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.time_in_session_min, event_name: $('Match vs HubSpot').item.json.event_name }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: 1, filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: $json.company_domain ? 'domain' : 'name', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.company_domain || $json.company_name }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: 200, properties: 'firstname,lastname,email,jobtitle,company,country,event_name,event_attendance_status,time_in_session_min,questions_asked,lifecyclestage,hubspot_owner_id,job_function,seniority,company_industry,company_size_band,icp_tier,icp_score,icp_reason,region,dedupe_status,dedupe_reason,data_completeness_pct,data_completeness_before_pct,fields_missing_before,inferred_fields,enrichment_source'.split(','), filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'event_name', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.query.event || 'Darwinbox Cortex and the AI-Native Era of HCM' }] }] }) }}
